attempts.raw_response: Over time, Sangini became a vital resource for women across the city, offering not just immediate crisis intervention but also a safe space for dialogue and solidarity. The organization expanded its outreach through workshops, awareness campaigns, and collaborations with other rights-based groups. Volunteers were trained to handle sensitive cases with care, ensuring that every woman who reached out felt heard and respected. As word spread, more women began to access the helpline, and the group meetings grew into vibrant forums for shared experiences and collective healing. The founders believed that community building was just as important as emergency response, since isolation often compounded the trauma women faced. Through persistent effort, Sangini carved out a niche in the movement for women's rights, challenging stigma and advocating for dignity at every turn.

It aids people who want to leave their homes with legal procedures and to find job interviews later. Sangini has expanded operations to in Calcutta, Bombay, and Bangalore.

Activities since 2000
Since 2000, Sangini started visiting colleges and holding discussions to increase awareness on sexuality and about problems LBT and non-identifying women face. They started showing movies on the subject. They also started an initiative to spread awareness on safer sex at Tihar jail.

Awards
Betu Singh was awarded the KASHISH Rainbow Warrior Award on May 31, 2015. She was the first posthumous recipient of the award.  The award instituted in 2015 by KASHISH Mumbai International Queer Film Festival recognizes LGBTQ persons working on LGBTQ rights. Fashion designer and BJP leader Shaina NC handed the award to Betu Singh’s co-worker Maya Shanker.
pair.prefix: They started operating a shelter home for women from Vasant Kunj in Delhi. Later she worked with her partner Maya Shanker for Sangini. They set up a helpline for women to approach them and receive counselling. They also held group meetings to discuss problems and assist those in need of help. Sangini's focus has been on emergency support and to build a lesbian community. It has also taken up issues of domestic violence against straight women and helped victims.
